questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Integration Limits?
questions.answer: Integration limits translate a geometric region into inequalities. In multiple integrals, correct limits are as important as the integrand because the bounds decide which points are included.

questions.prompt: What does \(a\le x\le b\) mean in Integration Limits?
questions.answer: In Integration Limits, \(a\le x\le b\) means constant x-range.

questions.prompt: Identify another important piece of notation used in Integration Limits.

questions.prompt: Write limits for the triangle bounded by \(y=0\), \(x=0\), and \(x+y=1\).
questions.answer: Using vertical slices, \(x\) runs from \(0\) to \(1\). For each \(x\), \(y\) runs from \(0\) to \(1-x\). Thus \[\int_0^1\int_0^{1-x} f(x,y)\,dy\,dx\]

questions.prompt: Describe the same triangle using \(dx\,dy\).
questions.answer: Now \(y\) runs from \(0\) to \(1\). For each \(y\), \(x\) runs from \(0\) to \(1-y\): \[\int_0^1\int_0^{1-y} f(x,y)\,dx\,dy\]
